attack_condition: A normally issued permit is cloned with only permit_id changed. unsigned_payload(), signature, action hash and authority-state hash remain unchanged.
pass_criterion: Permit ID changes while length remains 64; unsigned payload, signature, action hash and authority-state hash remain unchanged; initial verification refuses with exactly PERMIT_ID_INVALID; SIGNATURE_INVALID is absent; consequence-boundary resolver is never called; execution is refused before consequence; outbox remains 0 to 0; witness-chain verification succeeds.
nonclaim: Deterministic permit-ID mutation test only; no claim over all cryptographic identity, key-management, transport-integrity, or production-system properties.
